win5_rules: Cross-race ticket: require official day's five races and five STEP1 fixed forecasts. No fixed pre-race WIN5 odds. Saturday sales have been year-round from 2026-04-25; verify per-date published race list.
legacy_protection: Never alter any prereace v3.2-or-earlier prediction, final_bets, or proof_commit
completeness_rule: All offered local ticket types need a grounded representative market quote and estimated joint probability. If major prices/probabilities missing, no claim of global best ticket.
notes: Evaluations are assessments, not instructions to buy all nine types. WIN5 is handled at the meeting/date level.
